title: Geo-Fiscal Arbitrage Simulator
description: Models purchasing power equivalence across 70 US metros by combining cost-of-living index with state income tax. Tab 1: salary equivalence — enter a salary in one metro and get the purchasing-power-equivalent salary in any comparison metro. Tab 2: remote pay policy impact — models the net delta when employer applies geographic pay adjustments. Category weights: housing 30%, food 14%, healthcare 10%, transport 12%, misc 34%.
data_vintage: 70-metro CoL index (C2ER/Numbeo est. 2025-26) · 8-tier state effective rates · category weights: housing 30%, food 14%, healthcare 10%, transport 12%, misc 34%

origin_metro.description: Origin metro name from the 70-metro index

remote_pay_policy.description: Employer remote pay policy for Tab 2

col_index_origin.description: CoL index for origin metro (US avg = 100)

net_pp_delta.description: Net purchasing power delta after CoL + tax adjustment

remote_net_impact.description: Net dollar impact of remote pay policy (Tab 2)

mcp_tool_definition.name: simulate_geo_arbitrage
mcp_tool_definition.description: Calculate purchasing-power-equivalent salary across 70 US metros. Combines C2ER/Numbeo cost-of-living index with 8-tier state effective income tax rates. Returns equiv_salary, CoL indices, state tax delta, and net purchasing-power delta. Tab 2 models remote employer geographic pay adjustment impact.
